test_title: PYST 4: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Mathematics (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Among 18 members of a cricket club, there are 2 wicketkeepers and 5 bowlers. In how many ways can a team of 11 players be selected to include only one of the wicketkeeper and atleast three bowlers?
solution:
**Given:**

Total members = 18

Wicketkeepers = 2

Bowlers = 5

Team size = 11 players

Condition: Select only 1 wicketkeeper and at least 3 bowlers

**Formula used:**

Ways = C(n, r)

**Calculations:**

Choose 1 wicketkeeper from 2: C(2,1) = 2

Remaining players to choose = 10

We will consider possible number of bowlers: 3 to 5

Case 1: 3 bowlers

→ C(5,3) = 10

Remaining 7 from non-wicketkeeper & non-bowlers = 18 - 2 - 5 = 11

→ C(11,7) = 330

Total = 2 × 10 × 330 = 6600

Case 2: 4 bowlers

→ C(5,4) = 5

Remaining 6 from 11 → C(11,6) = 462

Total = 2 × 5 × 462 = 4620

Case 3: 5 bowlers

→ C(5,5) = 1

Remaining 5 from 11 → C(11,5) = 462

Total = 2 × 1 × 462 = 924

Total ways = 6600 + 4620 + 924 = **12,144**

**∴ Required number of ways = 12,144**
